vidmuseCli.policy: Use the plugin-carried binary without a package download or automatic update.

openFonts.policy: A minimal curated pack distributed unmodified under OFL-1.1. Stage only selected families into a film project and carry each license and provenance receipt with it.

gbroCollageBroll.policy: Preserve the three-gate approval protocol, the editorial halftone paper-collage visual system, the prompt structure, and the QA standards. Replace the execution layer with VidMuse model serve through vidmuse-cli.

patches.vidmuse-vox: Replaced the upstream fixed 5-second clip with narration-driven duration: resolve voice and word timing first, split the script into arguments rather than sentences, and generate one clip per argument at a duration covering its measured narration span, phasing assembly across long spans. Added a mandatory voice spine using minimax/speech-2.6-hd for narration and doubao_speech/audio_text_alignment for word timing, both executed through vidmuse-media, because timing is the source of the duration plan; clips remain silent with narration carried separately. Repointed still generation from the Codex built-in image_gen tool to gpt-image-2, removing the upstream host-environment dependency. Repointed video generation from a direct gemini-omni-flash-preview API call to seedance-2.0-pro with minimax/hailuo-h3 as fallback, both taking a two-image first/last-frame request, defaulting to 720p. Required an explicit generation_type on multi-mode model calls. Trimmed the animation prompt's negatives to shot discipline only, dropping artifact-suppression negatives that current video models do not need and that can introduce the very content they name. Dropped GEMINI_API_KEY, the shared .omni-venv virtualenv, the google-genai dependency, check_setup.sh, generate_video.py, upload_file.py, and the legacy Veo script. Added result fetching, local verification, and per-beat provenance.json because VidMuse model runs return public URLs. Aligned artifacts to videos/<project>/.

excluded.scripts/check_setup.sh: vidmuse-cli owns authentication and dependency resolution.
excluded.scripts/upload_file.py: The CLI uploads local paths in supported media fields.
excluded.scripts/generate_veo_first_last.py: Upstream legacy path, already unused by default.
excluded.evals/evals.json: Codex-platform eval format this repo does not run.
excluded.assets/demo-*.gif: README demo media, not a runtime dependency.

hyperframes.policy: Pinned upstream domain skills with minimal VidMuse policy patches: no HyperFrames Studio/timeline UI and no HyperFrames-managed AI/media model selection or downloads.

vidmuse-design-frame-presets.contents: The complete official set of FRAME.md templates, caption skins, showcase HTML, and preset-local fonts.
vidmuse-design-frame-presets.policy: Keep as an optional user-visible gallery, inactive by default. VidMuse independently authors FRAME.md from the content and source unless the user explicitly selects a preset; then source analysis, human-presence rules, protected regions, and the approved project FRAME.md govern adaptation.

vidmuse-recut.policy: Preserve official styles, layouts, frames, fonts, GSAP asset, Storyboard v3, card HTML, composition, and media contract. Replace HyperFrames model-backed transcription and Studio review with VidMuse adapters, and override only the official card-count and placement heuristics with VidMuse content direction and visual-occupancy safety rules.

patches.hyperframes-core: Preserved the composition and planning contracts; replaced Studio review with snapshot review and routed media models to VidMuse.
patches.hyperframes-cli: Preserved unrelated CLI capabilities; removed Studio/timeline entry points and HyperFrames model-backed media preprocessing.
patches.hyperframes-animation: Kept deterministic animation knowledge; routed transcript timings to VidMuse media.
patches.hyperframes-keyframes: Unmodified; its timelines and models refer to animation/3D mechanics, not UI or AI models.
patches.hyperframes-registry: Preserved discovery, installation, wiring, templates, and contribution guidance; replaced preview validation with snapshots.

excluded.hyperframes-creative: The workflow skill remains excluded because vidmuse-design owns visual direction; its official frame-presets are vendored as a pinned resource subset.
excluded.creation-workflows: vidmuse-create and vidmuse-recut own film workflows.
